test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If the price of petrol increased by 7%, then by what percentage should the consumption be decreased by the consumer, if the expenditure on petrol remains unchanged?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If price increases by R%, reduction in consumption = [R ÷ (100 + R)] × 100%

Given, R = 7

⇒ Reduction % = [7 ÷ (100 + 7)] × 100%

⇒ Reduction % = (7 ÷ 107) × 100% = 700 ÷ 107 %

⇒ Reduction % = 6 ⁵⁸/₁₀₇ %

**∴ The correct answer is 6 ⁵⁸/₁₀₇ %.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price increase of petrol = 7%

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Price × Consumption
